meta.description: {name} in {regions}: details, rates and checked signals.

media.label: Media of {name}
media.empty: Photos appear here once they have been checked and approved.
media.emptyHint: Until then the profile shows a neutral area.

explanation.notImplied: What the signal does not say

identity.label: Identity checked
identity.checked: Legal age and identity with a verification provider, including a liveness check. The platform stores only the result, no copy of the ID.
identity.notImplied: The signal says nothing about services, rates or how a meeting goes. It is not a guarantee.

photos.label: Photos checked
photos.checked: Every photo shown was checked by hand before publication: permitted content and confirmed consent of the people shown.
photos.notImplied: The signal does not say that the photos are recent or unedited.

contact.label: Contact
contact.ownerBoth: Members can message you here and send a non-binding appointment request.
contact.ownerBookings: Members can send you a non-binding appointment request here.
contact.ownerMessages: Members can send you a message here.
contact.none: This profile does not accept requests through the platform at the moment.
contact.paused: This profile is paused at the moment
contact.restricted: Contact through the platform is not possible for this profile at the moment.

membersOnly.title: Only signed-in members can see this profile.
membersOnly.description: Sign in or create an account to view it.

owner.label: Your profile
owner.title: This is how visitors see your profile
owner.notReachable: Visitors cannot see this page at the moment.
owner.pendingChange: A change is under review; the current version applies until it is approved.

onboardingPreview.note: Once approved, your profile appears exactly like this in the marketplace.

state.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: The profile could not be loaded.
state.errorDescription: Saved details are not lost. Unsaved input stays stored in this tab.

fields.displayNameHint: Appears as the heading of your profile. A change is reviewed.
fields.shortDescriptionHint: One sentence below your name, at most 160 characters.
fields.languagesHint: Choose the languages you communicate in.
fields.descriptionHint: Appears under “About me”. At least 50 characters. No address and no contact details.
fields.contactWaysHint: Switching one on is reviewed, switching one off applies immediately.
fields.allowMessagesHint: Members can write to you through the platform.
fields.allowBookingRequestsHint: Members can request an appointment without obligation; you decide freely.
fields.visibilityPublicHint: Visible after the age check, even without an account.
fields.visibilityMembersHint: Visitors without an account see only your name and the way to sign in.
fields.locationLabelHint: General, for example “District 4”. Never an address.
fields.offerLater: You choose services once the categories have been approved.
fields.offerLaterHint: Until then your profile describes the offer through the description and rates.
fields.servicesHint: Choose from the centrally maintained categories.
fields.regionsPrivacy: Your exact address is never published. New regions are reviewed, removed ones apply immediately.
fields.regionsCount: {count, plural, one {# region selected, at most 10} other {# regions selected, at most 10}}
fields.ratesEmpty: No rates yet. Without rates the profile shows “Rates on request”.
fields.hideRateHint: The rate stays saved; visitors do not see it.

editor.title: My profile
editor.chooseSection: Choose a section to edit it. On the right you see the profile as visitors see it.
editor.reviewNotice: This change is reviewed before it becomes visible. Your current profile stays online in the meantime.
editor.pendingText: Until it is approved, visitors see the current version.
editor.pendingSince: Submitted on {date}. Until it is approved, visitors see the current version.
editor.rejectedTitle: Your last change was not applied. Reason given by the review:
editor.restored: Unsaved changes from this tab restored.
editor.panelDescription: The change applies to your public profile.
editor.unsavedTitle: Your changes are not saved yet.
editor.unsavedText: Save or discard them before you close the panel.

locked.inReview: Your profile is under review. Changes are possible again after the decision.
locked.blocked: Your profile is suspended or archived and cannot be edited. Support can help you.

leave.title: Leave the page with unsaved changes?
leave.description: Your input stays stored in this tab until you save or discard it. Visitors only see it after saving.

errors.generic: That did not work. Your input is still there; please try again.
errors.notAllowed: Only the person with this provider profile can edit it.
errors.locked: Your profile cannot be edited right now. Your input is still there.
